grants.title: 2048Wars
grants.description:
Onchain competitive 2048 game where players compete for a shared prize pot. Traditional sliding puzzle mechanics - first to reach 2048 tile wins the current pot.

Key Features:
- BuilderScore threshold prevents bot/sybil attacks
- Weekly win cooldown per player ensures fair distribution
- Small entry fee (i.e. 0.001 ETH per game)
- Growing pot system: 5% creator fee, 5% seeds next week's pot, 90% to winner
- If no winner, pot rolls over to next week
- Created as a Farcaster mini app

Tech Stack: JavaScript frontend + Solidity smart contracts

Personal Goal: Practice and advance my JS/TS & Solidity skills building an onchain game

grants.title: YieldGuard: An AI-Driven Cross-Protocol Yield Optimization Agent
grants.description: YieldGuard is an AI-powered asset management solution for DeFi. Leveraging advanced machine learning and risk management, it analyzes yields across Ethereum protocols and Layer 2 networks, identifying optimal allocations while accounting for gas fees, impermanent loss, and market volatility. Key features include an adaptive AI engine that predicts yield trends and adjusts strategies in real time; risk-adjusted optimization that integrates metrics like gas costs and impermanent loss; seamless cross-protocol integration via MPC Wallet APIs; and a transparent, intuitive dashboard offering real-time insights and customizable parameters, empowering exact, real-time investment management tailored for diverse investors.

grants.title: Fiidbak
grants.description:
Fiidbak is an identity-verified feedback platform where creators upload products as ERC1155 tokens and users provide quality reviews. Both creators and reviewers must verify identity (self protocol) to prevent spam and ensure authenticity.
Users earn progressive NFT badges based on approved feedback: Seedling (1 review), Wood (5), Bronze (15), etc. Feedback automatically approves after reaching fixed number of vote, and only Wood+ badge holders can vote on feedback quality, with weighted voting power. Product owners have feedback approval rights too. 
The platform transforms anonymous feedback into verifiable, merit-based contributions while scaling quality control through progressive user empowerment rather than centralized moderation.

grants.title: EthIndexer
grants.description: EthIndexer revolutionizes blockchain data access by enabling users to index blockchain data simply by typing natural language commands, without writing complex queries. It instantly processes your input and auto-generates API endpoints that both frontend and backend applications can consume—making blockchain data integration effortless and fast.EthIndexer is an AI-driven platform that empowers developers, analysts, and businesses to index and structure blockchain data on demand. Users describe what they want indexed—whether it’s activity for specific addresses or particular data fields—and EthIndexer automatically creates tailored REST APIs to expose this data for seamless integration.

grants.title: Gasless Polls: A Practical EIP-712 Implementation for Community Voting
grants.description:
My project is a Gasless Poll dApp to eliminate voting gas fees. Users sign free, off-chain EIP-712 messages, it gets batched together for a single, efficient on-chain transaction.
This project's goal is twofold: to solve a real user experience problem and to create a clean, open-source Scaffold-ETH 2 learning template for the BuidlGuidl community, demystifying gasless design patterns. Blockchain provides the core trust layer via cryptographic proof, immutable settlement, and transparency.
My 2-week plan is to deliver a functional MVP: a Solidity contract, a Node.js relayer, and a React frontend, complete with a detailed README and demo video. Future plans include decentralizing the relayer with GSN and adding token-gated voting for DAOs

grants.title: Festivify: NFT Greetings for Every Celebration

grants.title: MerkleProofX is a platform the process of generating, managing Merkle proof
grants.description:
MerkleProofX is a no-code platform that simplifies the generation, management, and verification of Merkle proofs for Web3 projects. It allows developers, platforms, and communities to securely run airdrops, create whitelists, and set up token-gated access without writing custom smart contracts or backend scripts.

Through MerkleProofX, users can upload wallet addresses, automatically generate a Merkle tree and root, and retrieve proofs. Features include on-chain storage of Merkle roots, API integration for dynamic proof generation, and pre-built smart contracts for claim verification. Developers can either deploy our lightweight verifier contract or use our APIs to fetch and verify proofs directly in their frontend apps.

grants.title: Scaffold-NFT
grants.description:
Scaffold-NFT will be a fork of SE2 which seeks to make the development of NFT projects as easy and intuitive as SE2 does for general smart contracts. Of course, Scaffold-NFT will laser in NFT development by providing template NFT smart contracts for ERC721, ERC115, dn404, and other NFT-like styles. Additionally, the frontend development side of the project will contain useful components to, again easily and intuitively, interact with NFT smart contracts and display the data retrieved from them. Finally, someone should be able to use the website to upload to IPFS, by integrating the nft.storage api.

The combination of all of these factors will make it so that the developer can go through the entire processes of building, testing, and deploying, their NFT projects quickly and easily customize them to fit their project's requirements. Alongside, having a handy framework on the frontend for rendering NFT data and intuitive controls for the user.

Thank you very much for your consideration.
Jacob Homanics

grants.title: savvy
grants.description:
An interface for the EVM in the browser, to simulate and visualize your onchain activity, with special emphasis on the costs associated with it.

Think ~ Etherscan + Remix + Foundry.

Basically, it's a way to interact with a forked EVM chain, in a local-first environment, with a comprehensive set of actions/hacks/utilities exposed by Tevm—which is doing all the heavy lifting.

The state of each chain is the initial fork + all the local transactions, which are displayed in the history with all the details (data, errors, logs, inputs...).

And also, and that's one of the main points of savvy, details on the gas usage of each transaction (fee, L1 submission fee if relevant...).

You can think of it as a way of simulating a set of transactions, and visualizing the results, without having to actually send them to the network.

With no setup (wallet, signatures, etc.), in the browser, from any account (impersonation), with any amount of native tokens.

And much more to come; see https://docs.svvy.sh/progress

grants.description: Basic understanding of the 🚩 Challenge #3: The Graph with basic explanations that are going to be helpful for the newcomers.

grants.title: External Contract UI
grants.description: A tool to improve the developer experience on scaffold-eth 2 by providing a tool to interact with external contract addresses

grants.title: DEGEN-STATION
grants.description: Degen Station is a raffle contract that allows for any individual to stake a certain amount of Eth with hopes of winning the grand prize which is 96% of the total stakes in the contract. Winners of each batch are also rewarded with an nft which. The is also a in built point system which is expected to tract users usage so that can be rewarded with the protocol tokens when it goes life.

grants.title: dstealth.xyz
grants.description:
Privacy is still a difficult problem to solve on blockchains.

Recent advances like ERC-5564 and Stealth Addresses help solve that problem.

The top privacy focused wallet on BASE providing account abstraction and stealth address features is fluidkey - they help users generate a new address each new time they receive funds, but this feature also presents new challenges for senders.

If sending money to someone's stealth address is the same as sending tokens to a entirely new 'fresh' address with no transaction history - what happens if the recipient claims you never paid them?

Dstealth helps solve this problem by using zkfetch (zktls) to prove that you ran a regex and retrieved an address from a users .fkey.id domain. (does tons more)

grants.title: Creating Privacy Paymaster for voting app similar to PrivacyPool app
grants.description:
Implementing a trustless ERC-4337 Paymaster for Privacy Pool application — fully on-chain, no relayers required. The `Privacy Pool Paymaster` is an ERC-4337 paymaster contract designed to sponsor Privacy Pool withdrawal operations. The Problem: Privacy Pools currently rely on centralized relayers, limiting permissionless access and decentralization.  The Fix: A custom on-chain Paymaster that validates Privacy Pool withdrawal proofs using verifiable, on-chain logic only. Benefits for users, apps & devs: - Compatible with any account - Refunds unused gas automatically - No external APIs or markups - Fully transparent, composable, and decentralized
- We will be building a similar paymaster for users of the anonymous voting application.

grants.title: Gasless DeFi Micro-Investment Pools for Communities
grants.description: We propose building a Gasless Community Micro-Investment dApp that enables small groups—such as friends, local clubs, or online communities (Telegram/Discord DAOs)—to pool ETH or stablecoins and invest together in DeFi strategies like yield farming, staking, or DEX liquidity provision. The platform removes one of the major pain points in DeFi: gas costs, by leveraging meta-transactions or ERC-4337 account abstraction. This allows each user to interact with the protocol—depositing or withdrawing—without needing to pay gas themselves, making it especially appealing to users with small amounts of capital. The protocol is powered by the ERC-4626 vault standard, which allows strategies to be modular and easily swapped out

grants.title: RealToken: Transparent Fractional Ownership for Real Estate
grants.description:
This project will develop a blockchain-based tokenization framework for real estate assets, enabling fractional ownership with built-in compliance mechanisms, such as KYC-based transfer restrictions.

MVP Scope
The initial phase will include:

A smart contract on an EVM-compatible blockchain to represent fractional ownership of properties.
A simple frontend for minting and transferring tokens, starting with a basic whitelist for KYC-approved participants.
A transfer validation mechanism to ensure only verified investors can trade these tokens.
A dividend distribution feature to facilitate automatic and transparent rental income disbursements to fractional owners using blockchain-based streams.

grants.title: DEX Price Alert dApp: Real-time Token Price Notifications
grants.description:
A decentralized application built on Scaffold-ETH 2 that allows users to set price alerts for any token pair on popular DEXes. Users can create personalized alerts for price targets, percentage changes, or volatility thresholds.

Key Features:
1 Monitor multiple token pairs across major DEXs
2 Set customizable price alerts with various trigger conditions
3 Real-time price tracking using DEX price feeds
4 Email/browser notifications when alerts trigger
5 User-friendly interface for managing multiple alerts

Built using Scaffold-ETH 2, the project will include smart contracts for alert management, a clean frontend interface, and notification infrastructure. All code will be open-source with clear documentation for community use and expansion.

grants.title: Solidity Debugger with Visualized State Changes
grants.description:
Problem Statement:
Existing Solidity debugging tools like Hardhat and Foundry lack intuitive state visualization, making it harder for developers, especially beginners, to debug efficiently and learn optimization techniques.

Proposed Solution:
Create a debugging tool that visually represents state changes across transactions. Add features such as real-time gas optimization suggestions, contract interaction flows, and educational snippets for error resolution.

Impact:
Lowers the barrier to entry for Ethereum developers by simplifying debugging.

Reduces deployment costs by optimizing contracts before mainnet deployment.

Builds community knowledge with educational content integrated into the tool.

grants.title: FairDrop: Simplifying Reward Distribution
grants.description:
FairDrop is a platform offering Airdrop as a Service, simplifying token distribution for projects. Projects can input the details of their airdrop campaigns, such as the token contract address, and upload a CSV of whitelisted recipient addresses. The platform then allows recipients to securely claim their rewards through an intuitive interface. By eliminating the technical complexities and risks associated with traditional airdrop methods, FairDrop ensures a seamless and accurate distribution process.

FairDrop streamlines token distribution, enabling projects to engage communities effectively regardless of technical expertise while fostering trust and promoting the adoption of accessible and reliable blockchain technologies.

grants.title: Admin Dashboard for Paymaster Using Scaffold-ETH
grants.description:
Hi, my name is Peter, and I am submitting a proposal for the final project for Batch #10.

The idea is to create an admin dashboard for a Paymaster, allowing users to top up their balances, moderate usage, and view activity. The dashboard will use Scaffold-ETH as the base template.

The Paymaster contract will be based on the reference implementation (https://github.com/eth-infinitism/account-abstraction).

Thank you for your consideration!

grants.title: Cross Chain Wikipedia
grants.description:
I've recently went through a full cycle of learning about cross chain transfers and protocols in general. I went from just knowing how to use a bridge to knowing exactly how a bridge works, by reading the documentation of the protocol, examining the call data, etc... I found that generally when you try to read the docs of a cross chain protocol, they all have their own language, and its very difficult to digest for someone new, specially to implement something on top of it. 
I want to create a wiki, that goes from the most simple concept of a cross chain protocol, demystifying it, maybe even creating the most simplest form of a cross chain protocol, and expand from there to the many and most famous cross chain protocols there are.

grants.title: Loans for renting houses
grants.description:
In Argentina, to rent a property you have to take out a guarantee insurance that costs up to 3 times the value of the monthly rent. My proposal is to create a smart contract that works as a guarantee, where the tenant stakes the guarantee amount, in case he stops paying the rent. Meanwhile, the funds will be deposited in aave so that they do not lose value. At the end of the contract, if the tenant complied with the conditions, he will be able to recover his stake.

This application proposes to solve a real-life problem through the implementation of a smart contract.

Technology that I should learn to use:
- Interact with usdc
- deposit usd in aave

grants.title: Gasless Cross-Chain Token Creation Framework For Devs (dApp, API, Widget)
grants.description: I want to build a framework designed to simplify meta-transaction-based cross-chain token creation specifically for developers, available through a dApp, API, or widget. Currently, users need to acquire cryptocurrency to pay gas fees for creating tokens, which makes onboarding new users complex and discourages users. My solution tries to remove these obstacles by allowing developers to integrate token creation functionality in their product. Utilizing meta-transactions, users only need to sign a message, while a relayer takes care of the blockchain transaction, covering gas fees. This solution streamlines token creation, making blockchain integration more accessible, and efficient for products and help attract new user-base to the platform.

grants.title: Blockchain-Powered Charity Platform
grants.description:
ZakatChain represents a unique opportunity to bring blockchain technology to a large, untapped market through a use case that resonates deeply with Islamic values and practices. 
By focusing on Zakat, we're not just building another crypto project – we're creating a gateway for millions to experience the benefits of Web3 while fulfilling their religious obligations.
This project will demonstrate the real-world utility of blockchain beyond speculation, potentially accelerating mainstream acceptance and use of cryptocurrencies on a global scale. Through ZakatChain, we aim to set a new standard for transparency, efficiency, and trust in charitable giving, while simultaneously driving significant blockchain adoption across the Muslim world.

grants.title: Decentralized torrent platform
grants.description:
This document outlines a decentralized torrent platform leveraging Ethereum for torrent metadata and IPFS/Arweave for descriptions. The frontend searches Ethereum and selected torrent sites, highlighting those found on Ethereum and scraping others for missing torrents. Users can add new torrents to the blockchain, ensuring greater availability and persistence.

Future enhancements include automated scraping funded by user donations and a “Hall of Fame” recognizing top contributors. This feature encourages active participation, building a robust, decentralized torrent repository on Ethereum.

You can find complete system design here: https://phantom-slip-78f.notion.site/Decentralized-Torrent-Platform-e1533e7b70d145acaf7708bfa747ba89

grants.title: Online Food Ordering System Proposal
grants.description: Hello, I want to create an online food ordering website. The user will come to the restaurant, then user will be able to order the dishes from the website. While completing the order, website will ask for user's table number. After the order is created, it will appear on the manager’s screen. Here, manager will be able to view the details of the order. Once the order is completed, the manager can mark it as delivered and remove it from the screen. This is my plan. If you have any suggestions, I would be happy to hear them. Thank you.

grants.title: Web 3 Survey Application
grants.description: Hello everyone, I want to create a Web3 survey application. If users provide consistent answers, they will receive a certain ETH reward. Some questions will be interrelated to measure whether users are answering consistently. If it is determined that a user has provided inconsistent answers, they will be blacklisted and will no longer be able to participate in the survey. Thank you very much for all the help you’ve provided so far.  See ya.

grants.title: Code Playground for dApp Development
grants.description:
An in-browser playground for dApp development that provides the ability to start dev work (including front-end code) within seconds!

HOW?
Send someone a link that will automatically:

1. Open StackBlitz
2. Start a Hardhat Network, `yarn chain`
3. Run `yarn deploy`
4. Run `yarn start`
5. DONE, you now have a full IDE in seconds

BENEFITS:
- Other tools (Remix) only focus on Smart Contract dev, but that's only HALF of the dev flow.

- Providing shared/repro links to common issues/examples will GREATLY improve the dev experience when debugging problems.

ISSUES:
1. This will require continued investigation into producing examples that fully work with WebAssembly (a limitation in web containers)

2. Non-localhost network comms are tricky

grants.title: Trustless Token System
grants.description: The platform enables the creation of decentralized token systems using blockchain technology for a wide range of applications. Users can easily create custom tokens for purposes such as food tokens, loyalty programs, event tickets, or community currencies. It supports transactions with USDT, ensuring seamless token issuance and management. Blockchain technology guarantees transparent and immutable transaction records, protecting against fraud and manipulation. The platform also should have an intuitive mobile app with NFC and QR scan capabilities, making token utilization straightforward and enhancing operational efficiency across different use cases.

grants.title: MarketMaker
grants.description: MarketMaker is a marketing platform designed for project owners who may lack the necessary connections or experience in marketing and PR. MarketMaker, hosts content creators and communities with high engagement, allowing project owners to utilize their marketing budget efficiently and profitably on a platform that benefits both parties. Project owners can open their own pools to let the content creators or communities create their own contents in a share of pool prize.

grants.title: Scaffold-Eth Desktop App
grants.description:
Hey gang, I'm 3vil7win, and this is my first proposal coming from batch 7.

I'd like to 'port' SE-2 to electron using at least one of the following wallet technologies: metamask electron sdk, walletconnect, or frame (it is not trivial to add extensions to an electron app, though it may be a possible expansion).

This project could be a good starting point for other developers to build desktop and mobile versions of dapps.

Electron apps are both an approach to frontend decentralization and a springboard to get dapps listed on mobile and other app platforms. I think these capabilities are definitely good extensions for SE-2.

I appreciate any thoughts y'all might have. Thanks!

grants.title: Privacy-Centric Data Marketplace: Secure and Rewarding Data Exchange for AI
grants.description: I aim to build a privacy-centric data marketplace where users can contribute valuable data through surveys. These surveys will be created by users of the platform, who will also attach monetary rewards to incentivize data contribution. Developers will be able to purchase these datasets directly from the survey creators. To ensure data privacy, I plan to use encryption and Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), which will allow developers to use the data without seeing or storing it, thus maintaining privacy and preventing data piracy. This marketplace is designed to facilitate both organized and unorganized data trading, targeting AI/ML developers and everyday users who want to contribute data securely.

grants.title: Treasure: Stake and Earn
grants.description: Treasure is an app that enables users to exchange Ethereum (ETH) for a specific token, stake this token for a defined period, and earn rewards based on an Annual Percentage Rate (APR). In addition to regular staking rewards, the app introduces a gamified element where users have a chance to win a bonus reward when the total amount of staked tokens reaches a predefined threshold. Users can also exchange the tokens back to ETH, ensuring liquidity and flexibility.

grants.title: iTheirs - IDea sharing platform.
grants.description:
iTheirs is a platform that allows you to create ideas that you think about. 
Those ideas that comes to your mind about a product or an invention that you want to be able to share with others or that you want to tag to a particular firm or company. This is what iTheirs gives you the ability to create.
You create these ideas and can either mark them as public or private, but either way. The ideas you create are stored on the blockchain and they are bound to you.
Benefits:
1. Because your idea on iTheirs becomes bound to you. If a company decides to reward an idea. They know who to reward.
2. iTheirs allow sharing of ideas without barriers.
3. iTheirs helps to know like-minded individuals and foster better relationships among such individuals.

grants.title: Video-Game Competitive Rank NFT's
grants.description:
As a gamer, you know that your in-game rank is more than just a number. It's a reflection of your dedication, skill, and progress within your favorite games. With Video-Game Rank NFTs, you can now immortalize your gaming profile rank as a unique, dynamically updating NFT. Players want to show off this rank using this NFT.
This NFT will dynamically display the rank of the user in game. The primary games that we can target is Dota2 it has free and open API's to get information.  We can allow the user to authenticate using Steam OpenID Auth to validate if they own that account and mint their own rank NFT which can display their in-game competitive rank. We can have the nft update periodically (every day or so) to automatically update the rank.

grants.title: Feedback Forge - Decentralized Feedback Platform
grants.description: Feedback Forge is a decentralized platform for providing and managing feedback in community-driven projects. Users can leave feedback with a 0-5 star rating and an optional comment. To ensure quality, only users with a certain reputation or those who stake Feedback Forge Tokens (FF) can give feedback. Users earn FF tokens for their contributions, incentivising active participation. This platform promotes transparency and continuous improvement by leveraging blockchain technology. Support for Feedback Forge will drive innovation in decentralized feedback mechanisms, that could be maybe used within BuidlGuidl ecosystem. For now, it's just an idea, for MVP I would like to buidl. I'm open to any feedback, pun intended, myself. Cheers!

grants.title: OnChain Crowdfunder
grants.description:
I'm looking to build a platform where people can share ideas that they need funding and others can invest in those ideas.

We know that sometimes to get a product out, there is a minimum investment needed. So if the investment goal isn't met, the ones who invested will receive their refund automatically.

If the goal is met, the money will go to the project owner (might need to stay in a contract so he can't rugpull) and the invertors receive a ERC (20 or 721).

The basic build will be the frontend where people can request funds / funds and the contracts on the backend.

grants.title: Dynamic NFT based on Weather API
grants.description: I would like to use chainlink functions with Scaffold-eth to consume a weather API and use the data to transform a user-dynamic NFT (different NFT for day and night and metadata). This is a basic proof of concept and if all goes well I want to use this template for a web3 game idea. The repo could be used as a template for anyone wanting to use scaffold eth and chainlink functions and get started quickly. Thank you.

grants.title: A decentralized token metadata provider
grants.description:
Currently, projects like TrustWallet and etherscan.io control if a token has a logo, and other information related to the token. 

A very centralized and expensive  process for new tokens with no guarantee that the token data will be updated after spending ~$500-2,500USD for each pull request.

I propose making this decentralized, storing logos on IPFS, allowing the contract deployer and owner the ability to update information about their token using a smart contract and a Scaffold-ETH frontend.

grants.title: Xplorer
grants.description:
Xplorer is a blockchain explorer designed with a focus on DeFi users, especially those in lending protocols. Initially launching as a minimum viable product (MVP), Xplorer aims to validate its innovative approach by tracking and documenting interactions between blockchain addresses and mainstream web2 applications like Uber and Amazon. This initial phase involves assigning points to blockchain addresses based on their off-chain activities, which are crucial for understanding a user's broader financial behavior.

The MVP will leverage this data through smart contracts to compute an on-chain trust score for each address. This score aids DeFi platforms in refining lending terms, enhancing risk management, and offering personalized services.

grants.title: jekyll-frames
grants.description: Jekyll plugin to enable any Jekyll website to work with Frames.

grants.title: Grey hat
grants.description:
A smart contract that any protocol could implement in the event of an exploit. Hackers can deposit the exploited funds into the smart contract and automatically receive a portion of the funds back as a bounty. Additionally, the hacker could negotiate the percentage they receive.

This project aims to encourage hackers to return the funds.

grants.title: Light
grants.description: Light enables users to interact with all EVM chains like it is one through a EVM chain abstraction stack: https://github.com/LightDotSo/LightDotSo
